text: {"claims":[{"quote":"we expect the group order inflows to grow in the range of 10% to 12% in FY27","metric":"order inflow growth","promised":"10%‑12% order inflow growth","horizon":"FY27"},{"quote":"On Revenue, we expect growth to be in the range of 10% to 12% for FY27","metric":"revenue growth","promised":"10%‑12% revenue growth","horizon":"FY27"},{"quote":"we expect the same to be stable as well in FY27 as well","metric":"Projects, Products and Manufacturing margin","promised":"margin stable at 7.8%","horizon":"FY27"},{"quote":"guiding the working capital to be around 10% in FY27","metric":"working capital to revenue ratio","promised":"working capital ~10% of revenue","horizon":"FY27"},{"quote":"Lakshya L31 targets 13% to 15% revenue CAGR growth for over five years with EBIT margins of 16% to 17%","metric":"revenue CAGR and EBIT margin","promised":"13%‑15% revenue CAGR, 16%‑17% EBIT margin","horizon":"FY27‑FY31"},{"quote":"targeting order inflow growth at a CAGR return of 10% to 12%, revenue growth of 12% to 15%, and a Return on Equity in the range of 16%","metric":"order inflow CAGR, revenue CAGR, ROE","promised":"order inflow CAGR 10%‑12%, revenue CAGR 12%‑15%, ROE ~16%","horizon":"FY27‑FY31"}]}
